subject.title: bug(cost): mid-session writes to bootstrap-injected files trigger cacheWrite spiral on long agentic sessions; bootstrap-cache.ts shipped for #43532 is content-equality, not session-freeze

question: Should OpenClaw preserve live bootstrap-file visibility by default, or add an opt-in/session-level cache-stable bootstrap contract for volatile workspace files?
rationale: The source evidence shows the reported behavior, but changing it affects user expectations for whether AGENTS.md, MEMORY.md, and related files update inside an active session.

options.title: Opt-in cache-stable mode
options.body: Preserve the current live default while adding a tested opt-in mode or dynamic-file boundary for volatile bootstrap files and documenting the cost tradeoff.

options.title: Session freeze semantics
options.body: Implement session-freeze behavior for bootstrap-injected files so system-prompt copies stay fixed until rollover or compaction, with file tools still reading live disk.

options.title: Docs-only clarification
options.body: Keep runtime behavior as live refresh and explicitly document that volatile bootstrap-file writes can invalidate Anthropic cache prefixes.

recommendation.title: Opt-in cache-stable mode
recommendation.body: Preserve the current live default while adding a tested opt-in mode or dynamic-file boundary for volatile bootstrap files and documenting the cost tradeoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant recent history is in prompt-cache boundary and continuation-skip context-injection work.
